name: Dry Drowning
source:
Dry Drowning is an investigative thriller-oriented visual novel set in 2066 in the dystopian universe of Nova Polemos, a fictional north European city.

By following the story of Mordred Foley, unscrupulous private detective haunted by his dark past, the player will be immersed into a series of macabre serial killings inspired by ancient Greek myths.

Thanks to its peculiar art style, dynamic soundtrack and interactive gameplay, tied together by a story filled with different outcomes and multiple choices, Dry Drowning aims at rejuvenating the genre telling an extremely compelling and mature story.

[From the [url=http://vlgpublishing.com/drydrowning/]English official site[/url]]
translation:
《Dry Drowning》是一部以调查惊悚为主的视觉小说，背景设定在2066年的反乌托邦宇宙诺瓦波莱莫斯（Nova Polemos），一座虚构的北欧城市。

跟随莫德雷德·弗利（Mordred Foley）的故事，莫德雷德·弗利是一个肆无忌惮的私家侦探，他的黑暗过去一直困扰着他，玩家将沉浸在一系列受古希腊神话启发的恐怖连环杀人事件中。

由于其独特的艺术风格、动感的配乐和互动的游戏玩法，再加上充满不同结果和多重选择的故事，《干溺》旨在重振这一类型，讲述一个极其引人入胜且成熟的故事。

[摘自[url=http://vlgpublishing.com/drydrowning/]英文官方网站[/url]]
